test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given sentence and select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word 'Deplete' from the following options.

Depletion of old things has become a fancy business as it brings back old memories but at a high cost.
solution:
The correct answer is __**restore**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Deplete"** means to to consume or reduce to a very low amount; use up.
 
• The antonym of the word **Depletion** are restoration, step-up, addition, increase etc.
 
• From the antonyms of the given word, we can say that word **'restore' **is the **opposite in meaning.**
 
• The word restore means, to bring back to a normal condition.

Hence, the correct answer is **option 1.**
